The weighted campus energy balance calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the core logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the legacy pytest suite in test_output.py without exceptions. While the judge_reward of 0.66 suggests potential for optimization in code style or edge-case handling, the primary energy balance algorithm is functional. Future iterations should verify the handling of zero-weight inputs or missing energy metrics to ensure stability across diverse campus datasets.
